labeling_note: Browser-agent library/application supporting many LLM providers; model-owned artifacts are not applicable.

criteria.rationale: Project dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml.
A Dockerfile provides a containerized environment.
The browser-agent project does not own a dataset pipeline.
The framework supports many model providers and does not own a model card.
MIT applies to the code; no project-owned model license is involved.
The repository provides test and evaluation scripts for executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the browser-agent project.
Tests, CI and setup scripts are present.
Prompt examples are provided, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
Model and reasoning settings are shown in examples, but no fixed sampling configuration is documented.
This is a browser agent, not a RAG application with a project-owned index.
Agent execution exists, but no mandatory tool-call trace artifact is documented.
A benchmark is mentioned, but data splits and contamination analysis are not documented.
Pricing and benchmark cost are mentioned, but no reproducible project-level cost or latency measurement is provided.
